The younger sister of Stephen Hubbard, the US citizen freed Wednesday after spending more than four years in a Russian prison, said her brother didn’t realize he was being released until he was put aboard a plane and saw the American flag.

“He didn’t know why he was being taken from the prison to Moscow, and he may have thought he was going to his death,” Patricia Hubbard Fox said during an interview Thursday in San Antonio, where her brother was taken for evaluation.

“He’s been kind of laughing a lot,” she added. “Like relief laughing. ‘Oh my God, you know, I’m free. This is really happening.’”

President Donald Trump said he had asked Russian President Vladimir Putin during a phone call earlier this month to free Hubbard, a 74-year-old retired teacher from Michigan.

Hubbard was accused of fighting alongside Kyiv’s forces after Russia’s full-scale invasion of the country in 2022.

In 2024, he was sentenced in closed court proceedings to nearly seven years in prison.

The US government under the Biden administration had designated Hubbard as wrongfully detained, and his legal team also disputed the Russian allegation, saying he was not involved in any military activity.

Hubbard Fox said her brother was starved and beaten so severely in prison that some of his fellow inmates from Ukraine had to carry him.

“The only English they knew was ‘Die, American. Die,’” she said of the Russian guards. “And that just made him mad enough to not die, you know? ‘I’ll show them.’ I’m so proud of him.”

Hubbard, a US Air Force veteran, taught English overseas and retired in 2012 to Cyprus, where one of his sons is an Orthodox Christian priest.

He later moved to Ukraine to be with a woman he had met, his lawyers said, and remained in the country after the relationship ended.

He was living there at the time of Russia’s invasion.

Hubbard Fox said she didn’t know where her brother was until a woman in Ukraine tracked her down after seeing a prison roster with his name on it.

“God doesn’t answer prayers immediately sometimes, but he always answers my prayer,” Hubbard Fox said. “And I said, ‘Jesus, get him home.’”

She said in a separate interview Wednesday that her brother would probably come live with her in Colorado, and they both were looking forward to a family reunion.
news.content: بیشتر پوشش ما را در نتایج جستجوی خود مشاهده کنید. خواهر کوچکتر استفان هوبارد، شهروند آمریکایی که روز چهارشنبه پس از گذراندن بیش از چهار سال در زندان روسیه آزاد شد، گفت که برادرش تا زمانی که سوار هواپیما شده و پرچم آمریکا را نبیند متوجه آزادی او نشده است. پاتریشیا هوبارد فاکس روز پنجشنبه در مصاحبه ای در سن آنتونیو، جایی که برادرش برای ارزیابی برده شد، گفت: "او نمی دانست چرا او را از زندان به مسکو می برند و شاید فکر می کرد که به سمت مرگ می رود." "مثل خندیدن آرامش بخش. "اوه خدای من، می دانی، من آزادم. این واقعاً اتفاق می افتد." دونالد ترامپ، رئیس جمهور آمریکا گفت که اوایل ماه جاری طی یک تماس تلفنی از ولادیمیر پوتین، رئیس جمهور روسیه خواسته بود که هابارد، معلم بازنشسته 74 ساله ای از میشیگان را آزاد کند. هابارد پس از تهاجم همه جانبه روسیه به کشور در سال 2022 به جنگ در کنار نیروهای کی یف متهم شد. در سال 2024، او در یک دادگاه غیرعلنی به هفت سال زندان محکوم شد. دولت ایالات متحده تحت دولت بایدن هابارد را به عنوان بازداشتی غیرقانونی معرفی کرده بود، و تیم حقوقی او نیز با ادعای روسیه مخالفت کرد و گفت که او در هیچ گونه فعالیت نظامی شرکت نداشته است. هوبارد فاکس گفت برادرش در زندان از گرسنگی گرسنگی و ضرب و شتم شدیدی گذشت که برخی از همبستگانش از اوکراین مجبور شدند او را حمل کنند. و این فقط او را دیوانه کرد

news.originalContent:
Support crucial from president of 47-nation AFC, who had been a critic of Gianni Infantino over his failed private investment plan.

The head of the Asian Football Confederation (AFC) says the body is endorsing Gianni Infantino for another term as FIFA president.

The AFC has 47 member confederations. Even if all the members do not follow Friday’s direction from Sheikh Salman bin Ibrahim Al Khalifa, those that do could be key to guaranteeing another mandate for Infantino, who leads the governing body of world football and is seeking a fourth term.

The FIFA election is in March. The deadline for candidates to file against Infantino is November 18, and so far, none has filed.

Sheikh Salman, speaking at the AFC’s extraordinary congress in Tokyo on Friday, embraced Infantino with a large hug in front of the membership as he delivered his endorsement.

“We affirm our full commitment to supporting you and your leadership as you seek a new mandate as the FIFA president.” Sheikh Salman said.

“You’ve visited a lot of countries in Asia. I’ve spoken to a lot of members within this continent. I know your feeling, and I think your commitment is clear as well.”

Addressing his remarks to Infantino, Sheikh Salman indicated not every AFC member would go along with the endorsement but most will.

“My feeling is, I’m sure, the feeling of most of my members,” the AFC president said. “And I’ve said that to you.”

This is an abrupt turnaround for Sheikh Salman. Just over two months ago, the AFC joined the football governing bodies of Europe and that of North and Central America in saying Infantino had committed a “fundamental breach of trust”.

Infantino apologised last week in Zurich to FIFA’s 37-member ruling council, which he chairs, for “mistakes” he made in assembling a now-scrapped $4.2bn plan to sell a stake in FIFA events, including the World Cup, to private investors.

Sheikh Salman referenced the differences with Infantino in his speech but glossed over any details.

“Gianni, I want to make it clear: Yes, we had some issues we spoke about in the past,” Sheikh Salman said. “But let’s not relate the two things together. I think the last few days we met in Zurich, you made it clear that there’s a true understanding between us.”

“The past I’m sure is part of our history,” he added, “We’ve all, I’m sure, learned important lessons from it. What matters now is how we move forward together. I think everyone has questions, and I’m sure the answers will be available, whether to us in Asia or the rest of the world. ”

FIFA’s media office has been promoting Infantino’s travels around the world, seeking votes in exchange for millions of more dollars in financial support for small and large football countries.

“Thank you for being here,” Sheikh Salman said to Infantino. “I know you have been everywhere. I don’t know how you can do it. But I’m sure that you set a record for being in almost every country.”

Sheikh Salman then joked that, perhaps, Infantino had a “clone”.

That drew a laugh. But the largest applause came at the end of his brief address when he again repeated his support for Infantino.

“As one Asian family, we are ready to move forward, united in your support, Gianni,” Sheikh Salman added. “I want to make that clear today.”

Infantino took the podium after Sheikh Salman and kept his remarks light. But he did acknowledge some errors.

“When you do many things, you do – hopefully, as we did, many good things – you do some mistakes as well,” Infantino said. “The important, however, is, as you said, to learn, to learn always from the experience, from the mistakes, to apologise, to move ahead, to come together, to unite, to build for our future, for your future.”

The largest applause came as he mentioned how, under his leadership, millions more are flowing to FIFA’s patronage network.

“Before I started as FIFA president, each of you – some of you are still [here] and still remember that time – each of you was receiving $1m every four years” Infantino said. “As of the first of January of next year, it will be $25m.”
news.content:
حمایت رئیس 47 کشور کنفدراسیون فوتبال آسیا، که از جیانی اینفانتینو به خاطر طرح سرمایه گذاری خصوصی شکست خورده اش انتقاد کرده بود، بسیار مهم است. رئیس کنفدراسیون فوتبال آسیا (AFC) می گوید که این نهاد از جیانی اینفانتینو برای یک دوره دیگر به عنوان رئیس فیفا حمایت می کند. AFC دارای 47 کنفدراسیون عضو است. حتی اگر همه اعضا از دستور روز جمعه شیخ سلمان بن ابراهیم آل خلیفه پیروی نکنند، اعضایی که این کار را انجام می دهند می توانند برای تضمین یک مقام دیگر برای اینفانتینو، که رهبری هیئت حاکمه فوتبال جهان را بر عهده دارد و به دنبال چهارمین دوره ریاست جمهوری است، کلید بخورند. انتخابات فیفا در ماه مارس برگزار می شود. آخرین مهلت کاندیداها برای تشکیل پرونده علیه اینفانتینو 18 نوامبر است و تاکنون هیچ کدام ثبت نام نکرده اند. شیخ سلمان که روز جمعه در کنگره فوق‌العاده کنفدراسیون فوتبال آسیا در توکیو سخنرانی می‌کرد، اینفانتینو را با در آغوش گرفتن بزرگ در مقابل اعضا در حالی که تاییدیه‌اش را ارائه می‌کرد، در آغوش گرفت. شیخ سلمان گفت: "شما از کشورهای زیادی در آسیا دیدن کرده اید. من با بسیاری از اعضای این قاره صحبت کرده ام. من احساس شما را می دانم و فکر می کنم تعهد شما نیز واضح است.»
شیخ سلمان در خطاب به اینفانتینو اظهارات خود را به اینفانتینو اشاره کرد و گفت که همه اعضای کنفدراسیون فوتبال آسیا با این تایید همراهی نمی کنند، اما اکثر آنها این کار را می کنند. "و من این را به شما گفته ام."
این یک چرخش ناگهانی برای شیخ سلمان است. کمی بیش از دو ماه پیش، AF

news.originalContent:
Manchester United manager Michael Carrick is under growing pressure, but club legend Wayne Rooney takes aim at players.

Manchester United great Wayne Rooney has labelled the current squad “babies” and “selfish” after a humiliating Champions League capitulation and post-match criticism by Bruno Fernandes of manager Michael Carrick.

Carrick’s men are 13th in the Premier League before Sunday’s visit by Bournemouth and could drop into the bottom three if results go against them this weekend.

With the club beset by infighting and off to their worst domestic league start for decades, Carrick was left clinging to his job after the 4-1 defeat at Como on Wednesday.

Deepening the sense of crisis, the captain Fernandes afterwards took aim at his manager’s tactics, saying United had to be more “brave”.

Defender Lisandro Martinez criticised the club’s board last week for not investing enough in the transfer market.

Rooney, United’s all-time leading goalscorer, said he was in “shock” and “disbelief” at the Como display.

A friend and ex-teammate of Carrick, former striker Rooney pointed the finger at the players.

“When Martinez came out, I said this is an absolute nightmare because it will rip the dressing room apart,” Rooney told The United Stand podcast on Thursday.

“That was the start. We’ve seen it now with Bruno and you’re going to see it with more players because these players, they don’t want to take responsibility.

“You can say whether Bruno was right or wrong in what he said but you have to take responsibility on the pitch. You have to take responsibility as a group of players.”

He added: “These players, they’re selfish. They don’t care about their teammates, don’t care about the manager, the staff or the fans; they care about themselves.

“If they’re not getting what’s right for them, they’re like babies and just throw their toys out of the pram and go and deflect the blame on to anyone else but themselves.”
news.content: مایکل کریک، سرمربی منچستریونایتد تحت فشار فزاینده‌ای قرار دارد، اما وین رونی، اسطوره باشگاه، بازیکنان را مورد هدف قرار می‌دهد. وین رونی، بزرگ منچستریونایتد، پس از تسلیم تحقیر آمیز لیگ قهرمانان اروپا و انتقادات پس از بازی توسط برونو فرناندز از سرمربی مایکل کریک، تیم فعلی را "کودک" و "خودخواه" نامید. مردان کریک قبل از دیدار یکشنبه بورنموث در رده سیزدهم لیگ برتر قرار دارند و اگر نتایج آخر این هفته با آنها مخالف باشد، می توانند به رده سوم جدول سقوط کنند. در حالی که باشگاه درگیر جنگ داخلی و بدترین شروع لیگ داخلی برای دهه ها بود، کریک پس از شکست 4-1 در کومو در روز چهارشنبه به کار خود چسبید. پس از آن، کاپیتان فرناندز با تشدید احساس بحران، تاکتیک‌های سرمربی خود را مورد هدف قرار داد و گفت یونایتد باید «شجاع‌تر» باشد. لیساندرو مارتینز مدافع هفته گذشته از هیئت مدیره باشگاه به دلیل سرمایه‌گذاری کافی در بازار نقل و انتقالات انتقاد کرد. رونی، بهترین گلزن تاریخ یونایتد، گفت که او در نمایش «شوک» و «همکار سابق» بود. کریک، مهاجم سابق رونی انگشت خود را به سمت بازیکنان گرفت. رونی روز پنجشنبه به پادکست یونایتد استند گفت: "وقتی مارتینز بیرون آمد، گفتم این یک کابوس مطلق است زیرا رختکن را از هم خواهد پاشید." "این شروع کار بود. ما اکنون آن را با برونو دیدیم و شما آن را با بازیکنان بیشتری خواهید دید زیرا این بازیکنان نمی‌خواهند مسئولیت را بر عهده بگیرند."

Orla Baxendale’s family and estate cannot hold CEO Stew Leonard Jr. and other grocery employees individually liable in their wrongful death claims under the Connecticut Product Liability Act (CPLA), Waterbury Superior Court Judge Kimberly Massicotte ruled Oct. 15, according to court documents obtained by Allergic Living.

However, the product liability claims will still proceed against Stew Leonard’s Holdings LLC, Stew Leonard’s Danbury LLC and Cookies United, a Long Island-based wholesaler that manufactured the cookie.

Baxendale, 25, died from anaphylactic shock after suffering an allergic reaction when she ate a vanilla Florentine cookie from a box bearing the Stew Leonard’s brand name at a social gathering in Connecticut on Jan. 11, 2024.

An investigation into the young dancer’s death found that the cookie’s packaging did not list peanuts, to which Baxendale was severely allergic.

An EpiPen was used in an attempt to save her life, “but due to the severity of her allergy, it was not effective,” an attorney representing her estate previously said.

Baxendale, a native of Manchester, England, moved to New York in 2018 to train as a scholarship student at The Ailey School.

Before her death, she had worked with various choreographers and appeared in numerous professional productions, including at New York Fashion Week and at Lincoln Center.

Following her death, Baxendale’s estate and family filed a sweeping wrongful death lawsuit, accusing the defendants of negligence for failing to properly label the package.

Stew Leonard’s has maintained that Cookies United swapped soy nuts for peanuts in the cookie recipe without alerting the chain’s chief safety officer.

Cookies United, however, has said it gave Stew Leonard’s notice of the change in July 2023, emailing several of the grocer’s employees — all of whom were named in the original wrongful death lawsuit — that peanuts had been added, according to Allergic Living.

Baxendale’s estate alleged that Stew Leonard’s employees failed to act on the emails, leaving peanuts off the label.

Massicotte had previously dismissed all claims against individual Stew Leonard’s executives and employees on Sept. 16, 2025, but Baxendale’s attorneys amended the lawsuit under the CPLA, again naming Stew Leonard’s, Cookies United and individual employees, including Stew Leonard Jr., court documents show.

Despite the ruling shielding individual executives and employees, Baxendale’s estate attorney, Howard Hershenhorn, said it won’t stop them from holding Stew Leonard’s accountable for its “reckless” conduct.

“Stew Leonard’s did not have any systems in place to make certain that ingredients that were contained within the product were absolutely listed on the labels,” Hershenhorn told Newsday.

“They had no fail-safe systems in place at the time.”

The attorney also blasted the grocer for doing “nothing to progress the case forward except for obfuscate and attempt every potential procedural maneuver.”

“We’re having none of it and we’re right back in their face at every point to make sure this never happens again,” Hershenhorn told Allergic Living.

Since Baxendale’s death made national headlines, other Stew Leonard’s customers have contacted his firm about labeling problems they claimed to have experienced at the grocery store, Hershenhorn said.

As part of a settlement with the state, Stew Leonard’s paid $50,000 to Connecticut’s Department of Consumer Protection and donated $200,000 to a food allergy and anaphylaxis nonprofit, according to Newsday.

The case is scheduled to go to trial in Waterbury Superior Court in May 2027.

news.originalContent:
Al Jazeera interviews Fatih Birol in Berlin as the Iran war disrupts global energy supplies.

Berlin, Germany – Europe is entering winter with historically low gas reserves and cannot withstand further supply shocks, Fatih Birol, head of the International Energy Agency, has warned, as the US-Israel war on Iran disrupts global supply chains.

Speaking to Al Jazeera on the sidelines of an international conference in Berlin on Wednesday, Birol said all regions are being hit by energy disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz but that Europe is particularly vulnerable and will likely face rising costs of liquefied natural gas (LNG) in the coming months – even if peace returns to the Gulf today.

“The best day for a ceasefire would have been yesterday,” the energy economist, whose agency advises wealthy member nations and coordinates emergency responses, said.

“Normally before the winter, European countries have a lot of gas stocks, but the gas stocks we have while we are entering this winter are much lower than historical averages,” he said, adding that Europe’s gas is competing with that of Asian countries, which are even more dependent on the Middle East.

“I think if we have a harsh winter, we may see higher prices of natural gas in Europe,” Birol said, adding that the increasingly political nature of energy adds to the uncertainty. “Life will not be easy for Europe this year and also next year.”

European nations have long relied on imported gas to generate electricity for industries and warm homes in the freezing winter. Nearly a 10th of the continent’s LNG transited through the Hormuz Strait before the war. However, Iran’s attacks on vessels have plummeted imports.

As the winter chill settles, the European Union’s natural gas storage is only 72 percent full, down from the usual 90 percent. The shortfall is equivalent to the energy needed to power 10 to 12 million homes, analysts say.

EU energy ministers are now mulling over whether they should ask households and businesses to ration consumption, according to news reports.

Birol said he had long thought about the dangers of relying on the Strait of Hormuz. In fact, he said, his standard question to recruits seeking to join his agency was often: What would they do if the strait shuts down today?

The fallout has hardly come as a surprise. The flare-ups in the alternative Bab al-Mandeb strait, he added, have only worsened things.

“World leaders, how do they think?” Birol, who was born in Turkiye, said in his usual measured tone.

“I am really disappointed that governments didn’t take the necessary measures. Now, everybody is in a hurry, taking measures; the Middle East countries are building new pipelines, expanding the new pipelines that are bypassing the Strait of Hormuz … but in my view, these efforts should have been done much earlier.”

The EU, whose ageing refineries have processed less crude in recent years, also faces shortages of imported refined products such as the diesel that powers the bloc’s trucking, agricultural and industrial sectors.

Birol said Ukraine’s attacks on Russian refineries were also behind a looming diesel scarcity. About a third of Russian deliveries have stopped coming, he said.

When the Group of Seven (G7) nations agreed to push 400 million barrels of crude and diesel from their strategic reserves in March, it was Birol who coordinated how those emergency stocks reached global markets – the third time he has had to oversee emergency stock releases since Russia’s invasion of Ukraine in 2022.

For years, the energy economist said, his agency warned that the bloc was too tethered to Russia’s fuel, and that it had turned away too early from nuclear-generated power, which gave countries domestic leverage.

When Russia invaded Ukraine, his warnings manifested after Moscow cut gas supplies in retaliation for sanctions. The EU plans to permanently phase out Russian gas, but amid the Gulf crisis, members like France have again stepped up orders.

Industry experts say emergency reserves that hit the market have limited use, as some estimate only a few months will be covered.

But Birol argued that his agency recorded real impact – a $20 drop in soaring oil prices immediately after the G7 countries agreed to release 100 billion barrels of crude oil and diesel earlier this month.

Prices are, however, on the rise again. Gas has surged by 140 percent since February, and Brent crude is trading well above $100.

Whatever happens now, the war will be felt for months, Birol pointed out, adding that it has irrevocably altered how energy will travel around the world.

It is also altering Europe’s politics, Birol noted. Russia has wielded gas as a weapon. And populist parties, from France to Germany, are capturing growing public anger to frame mainstream governments as incompetent.

“I have never ever seen the dark and long shadow of geopolitics so dominant in the energy sector,” Birol mused. “The world has gone through so many difficult periods, but this is the worst in terms of the geopolitics dominating the energy game. Energy is not currently considered a business but a political leverage. As an energy man, this worries me.”

The EU still has about 80 percent of its emergency stocks, and Birol hopes he will not have to oversee a fourth release. But the world’s supply can’t take more shocks, he said.

“I really hope that both of the straits will be unconditionally opened sometime soon; otherwise, in the energy world, we don’t have much more buffer zones to still keep the prices at a certain level (as) we have today,” he concluded.

الجزیره با فاتح بیرول در برلین مصاحبه می کند زیرا جنگ ایران عرضه جهانی انرژی را مختل می کند. برلین، آلمان – فاتح بیرول، رئیس آژانس بین المللی انرژی، هشدار داده است که اروپا با ذخایر کم گاز تاریخی وارد زمستان می شود و نمی تواند در برابر شوک های عرضه بیشتر مقاومت کند، زیرا جنگ آمریکا و اسرائیل علیه ایران زنجیره تامین جهانی را مختل می کند. بیرول روز چهارشنبه در حاشیه کنفرانس بین المللی در برلین با الجزیره گفت: تمام مناطق تحت تاثیر اختلالات انرژی در تنگه هرمز قرار گرفته اند اما اروپا به ویژه آسیب پذیر است و احتمالاً در ماه های آینده با افزایش هزینه های گاز طبیعی مایع (LNG) مواجه خواهد شد - حتی اگر امروز صلح به خلیج فارس بازگردد. این اقتصاددان انرژی که آژانس او ​​به کشورهای ثروتمند عضو مشاوره می دهد و واکنش های اضطراری را هماهنگ می کند، گفت: "بهترین روز برای آتش بس دیروز بود." وی با بیان اینکه به طور معمول قبل از زمستان، کشورهای اروپایی ذخایر گاز زیادی دارند، اما ذخایر گازی که ما در حال ورود به زمستان امسال هستیم، بسیار کمتر از میانگین های تاریخی است، گفت: گاز اروپا با کشورهای آسیایی که وابستگی بیشتری به خاورمیانه دارند، رقابت می کند. بیرول گفت: «فکر می‌کنم اگر زمستان سختی داشته باشیم، ممکن است شاهد افزایش قیمت گاز طبیعی در اروپا باشیم. زندگی برای اروپا در سال جاری و همچنین سال آینده آسان نخواهد بود.
کشورهای اروپایی برای مدت طولانی به گاز وارداتی برای تولید برق برای صنعت متکی بوده اند

A Utah man is facing several charges, including attempting to commit a hate crime, after he allegedly threatened to “blow up” a synagogue.

Skyler AJ Rose, 22, of Ogden, was indicted by a federal grand jury on Wednesday, on multiple federal charges, including possession of an unregistered destructive device, threatening to kill or injure people and destroy a building with an explosive, and attempting to commit a hate crime, among other offenses, according to the US Attorney’s Office for the District of Utah.

“There is no place for hate motivated violence—attempts or otherwise—in our communities. A place of worship should be a refuge of safety, not fear,” US Attorney Melissa Holyoak for the District of Utah said in a statement. “Thanks to the dedicated work of the FBI and the outstanding efforts of our local police partners, these alleged threats were identified and stopped before anyone was harmed. Let these charges serve as a clear warning: if you attack or attempt to attack a place of worship, you will face the full force of the federal government.”

On Dec. 23, 2025, Rose allegedly made multiple threatening posts on social media, according to court documents.

“I wanna blow up a synagogue,” one of the posts read, according to prosecutors.

An investigation was launched and authorities learned that the posts were made from an IP address tracing back to Rose’s home.

The FBI then contacted the Ogden City Police Department to assist, with a home visit where authorities said they confirmed the social media handle belonged to Rose.

Investigators executed a search warrant and recovered six improvised explosive pipe bombs and one inert device, explosive precursors and components that officials say could be used to construct further improvised explosive pipe bombs, a black Samsung cellphone and two rifles with accompanying magazines and ammunition, prosecutors said.

A subsequent search of Rose’s cellphone revealed that Rose searched online for a synagogue near him in November 2025.

“Today’s indictment stops in its tracks an alleged plan to carry out a violent attack on a synagogue,” Assistant Attorney General Harmeet K. Dhillon of the Justice Department’s Civil Rights Division said in a statement. “The Department of Justice will take decisive action to protect American worshippers from violent threats, no matter where they occur.”

Special Agent in Charge Robert Bohls of the Salt Lake City FBI added that “no one should have to fear for their safety because of their faith.”

“Every person deserves to worship freely, without threats, intimidation, or fear,” Bohls said. “The FBI takes every threat seriously. Thanks to the swift, seamless collaboration with our law enforcement partners, we were able to address the threat and protect lives from potential physical harm.”

The investigation also allegedly revealed evidence of child sexual abuse material on Rose’s cellphone, including hundreds of cached images and screenshots depicting child sexual abuse material, according to prosecutors. Rose was also indicted on charges of receipt and possession of child pornography.

Rose’s initial appearance is scheduled for Oct. 23 in federal court in Salt Lake City.

news.originalContent:
See more of our coverage in your search results.

The chief of New Zealand’s military, Air Marshal Tony Davies, resigned Friday after admitting to an inappropriate relationship as a unit leader.

“I regret not disclosing this when I had the opportunity to do so,” Davies said in his statement.

He didn’t elaborate on the circumstances of the relationship or when it happened.

Davies joined the country’s Air Force in 1984 and became chief of the New Zealand Defense Force in 2024.

The military said leadership was transitioning to its vice chief, Rear Admiral Mat Williams.

“The resignation is for personal reasons, and results from errors of judgment made by me in the past, for which I am taking responsibility,” Davies said.

“The errors of judgment were contrary to the values of the Defense Force.”

The military said in a statement that it wouldn’t comment further. The matter has been referred to an independent inspector-general who investigates military conduct.

Defense Minister Paul Goldsmith, an elected government official, said he had received the resignation. Goldsmith said in a statement that the situation was an “integrity matter” and he had agreed with Davies that his position was no longer tenable.

“I acknowledge his 42 years of service and his contribution to the New Zealand Defense Force, but note the circumstances of his resignation will be a great disappointment to the men and women of the Defense Force,” Goldsmith said.

Davies graduated from the US Air Force Air Command and Staff Course at Maxwell Air Force Base in Alabama in 2000, and the Royal College of Defense Studies in London in 2013, according to the New Zealand military’s website.

He was appointed a Member of the New Zealand Order of Merit in 1998 for his role in the midwinter evacuation of a critically ill US citizen from Antarctica.
news.content: بیشتر پوشش ما را در نتایج جستجوی خود مشاهده کنید. رئیس ارتش نیوزیلند، مارشال هوایی تونی دیویس، روز جمعه پس از اعتراف به رابطه نامناسب به عنوان رهبر واحد استعفا داد. دیویس در بیانیه خود گفت: «از اینکه این موضوع را فاش نکردم وقتی فرصت انجام این کار را داشتم، متاسفم. او توضیحی در مورد شرایط این رابطه نداد. دیویس در سال 1984 به نیروی هوایی کشور ملحق شد و در سال 2024 رئیس نیروی دفاعی نیوزیلند شد. ارتش گفت که رهبری در حال انتقال به معاون رئیس آن، دریاسالار مت ویلیامز است. "استعفا به دلایل شخصی است و ناشی از اشتباهات قضاوتی است که توسط من در گذشته انجام شده است." قضاوت مغایر با ارزش های نیروی دفاعی بود. ارتش در بیانیه ای اعلام کرد که اظهار نظر بیشتری نمی کند. این موضوع به یک بازرس کل مستقل ارجاع شده است که در مورد رفتار نظامی تحقیق می کند. وزیر دفاع، پل گلد اسمیت، یک مقام منتخب دولتی، گفت که استعفا را دریافت کرده است. گلداسمیت در بیانیه ای گفت که این وضعیت یک "موضوع یکپارچگی" است و او با دیویس موافقت کرده است که موقعیت او دیگر قابل تداوم نیست. گلداسمیت گفت: «من 42 سال خدمت و کمک او به نیروی دفاعی نیوزیلند را تصدیق می کنم، اما توجه داشته باشید که شرایط استعفای او ناامیدی بزرگی برای مردان و زنان نیروی دفاعی خواهد بود. دیویس از AI نیروی هوایی ایالات متحده فارغ التحصیل شد.

An Italian priest gave a group of far-left rioters the middle finger in sign of resistance against the agitators who took over the streets of Milan under the guise of student protests, pillaging the city with violence and looting.

Father Giannicola Maria Simone stood at the doorstep of the Church of Sant’Alessandro di Zebedia near the historic Piazza Sant’Alessandro as the mob of youngsters rushed by and gave them the universal sign to scatter off in front of a shocked parishioner after the violent protests erupted on Oct. 17.

The horde of masked instigators marched past the entrance of the towering parish church as the 65-year-old priest stood guard at the doors.

One of the unidentified agitators raised his hands, pointing both middle fingers at Simone, who nonchalantly returned the crude gesture, sticking up his left hand and flipping the bird, according to a now-viral video of the encounter.

Simone confessed to the flagrant act, debunking rumors that the viral video was AI, claiming he did it without violent intentions.

“It’s real, even if they’re now making up fake versions,” Simone told Italian newspaper Corriere Della Sera Thursday.

“It happened like this: as these young people were walking by, someone gave me the middle finger. They’re kids, so I’m not surprised. I gave them the middle finger back, but without any violent intentions or the risk of sparking further anger.”

The fearless cleric was not worried about the rioters damaging his church, saying they were clueless about why they were there.

“He did it because he saw me, but they were all running away,” he said.

Simone had been monitoring the violence occurring next door when he realized the hooded hoodlums were making their way towards the church.

The quick-thinking priest says he ushered scared tourists into the church to escape the violence.

“I was in the church watching what was happening… then I saw them pushing forward and spreading out into the side streets, and I ran to close the church,” Simone said. “There were lots of people fleeing the rioters, and I let them all in. They weren’t worshippers, but tourists and other passersby. They stayed here until the chaos passed.”

Simone doesn’t believe he needs to repent for his action against the rioters as he didn’t harm anyone.

“No, I don’t think we should talk about repentance. If I had thrown a punch, yes, but I’ve never raised my hand to anyone, not even in the most difficult moments. I’m 65 years old and I’ve worked with kids all my life, and every now and then you have to tell them, ‘Be careful what you do.’ I certainly would never have done something like that outside of the context of the fights.”

The priest spoke with some of the rioters who had arrived to the square, learning that some had just come because they were bored.

“We don’t know why we’re here, everyone came, so I came too,” Simone recalled one of the protesters telling him.

Violence and unrest broke out in Milan and other northern Italian cities when mostly young rioters robbed shops, vandalized buildings and attacked police officers.

Milan, Italy’s financial capital, was the focal point of initial protests against rising cost of living and public services before the reckless mob took over.

Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni and Defense Minister Guido Crosetto blamed the violence on

“The events in Milan and elsewhere in Italy are fundamentally different from those seen in other eras; they are the product of what I call ‘hybrid warfare’—a form of conflict being waged against our nations through unconventional tools like TikTok, social media, and YouTube,” Crosetto said in Rome, Ansa Italy reported.

Meloni condemned the violence and has since approved stricter security measures that will allow police to detain any minors between the ages of 14 and 17, even if they didn’t commit any crimes and impose tougher penalties for rioters.

“Thugs who exploit demonstrations to sow chaos, attack those who ensure security and hold entire cities hostage… Demonstrating is a right. Setting our cities ablaze is not,” Meloni said Saturday.

Meloni’s new anti-riot laws will also make parents financially liable for their children’s looting and vandalism.

Italy will also deploy 500 military troops to Milan for the remainder of the year to help control the protests.

“We know what it means to look for a job, to earn an insufficient wage, and to see no prospects for the future … but hardship must never be used as an excuse for violence,” Meloni said Tuesday.

A 58-yard field goal from Cairo Santos bailed out Caleb Williams late in Thursday night’s game after the Bears quarterback took a costly sack and almost knocked Chicago out of field goal range during a 30-24 win over the Patriots in Chicago.

The kick was the longest that Santos has kicked in his career, extending the Bears’ lead and preventing Drake Maye and the Patriots’ offense from getting the ball in good field position.

THE GUTS pic.twitter.com/NtgOLumfBD

The play before on a third-and-5, Williams dropped back to pass, but instead of finding a receiver, he started to scramble before being gobbled up by the defense and losing 10 yards.

The sack set up a long field goal for Santos.

The 13-year veteran NFL kicker put it through the uprights with 1:34 remaining to give Chicago a nine-point lead.

“These nights are awesome,” Williams said. “You play against another good team on a primetime game in a short week, these games are awesome because you get to see who you are as a team. That’s who we are. We’re a smashmouth football team, an innovative team. And when things happen and things don’t go our way and the water is rocky, we stay steady.”

It was a bit of a redemption story for Santos, who had failed to help the Bears take a two-score lead earlier in the fourth quarter.

A 53-yard miss — which hit off the right crossbar — with eight minutes left allowed the Patriots to hang around a little longer.

Luckily for Santos and the Bears, he made sure to make his next kick.

The Patriots were held to just a field goal on their subsequent drive, and they couldn’t recover the onside kick, sealing the win for the Bears. It was the Patriots’ first loss since Week 3.

بازی قبلی روی یک سوم و پنج، ویلیامز عقب افتاد تا پاس بدهد، اما به جای یافتن یک گیرنده، شروع به تقلا کرد قبل از اینکه توسط دفاع بلعیده شود و 10 یارد را از دست بدهد. اخراج یک دروازه طولانی برای سانتوس ایجاد کرد. ویلیامز گفت: "این شب ها فوق العاده است." There was no fanfare around a decision that was so obvious as to preempt suspense, but Thursday marked confirmation that the Islanders are planning for Victor Eklund to be around for the long haul this season.

Since the Islanders’ 3-2 defeat to the Kings in overtime was Eklund’s 10th game with the club this year, the Swede — who scored a power play goal in the loss— will officially burn a year of his entry-level contract. That is, of course, exactly what should happen, with Eklund having passed every test so far this season with flying colors.

“Honestly, we’ve played some teams, and some GMs go, ‘You know what, I noticed Eklund,’ ” Isles general manager Mathieu Darche said Wednesday. “He’s not the biggest guy, but even in the third yesterday, he’s one against three on the forecheck. He comes out from behind the net with the puck. He’s relentless. He has a dog-on-a-bone mentality.”

Indeed, though there was question about whether Eklund’s 5-foot-11, 175-pound frame would prove a hurdle to his effectiveness in the NHL, it hasn’t. The 20-year-old’s most evident qualities have been his physicality, play away from the puck and battle level, with an unusual level of detail in his game.

“I think his habits are really good naturally,” coach Pete DeBoer said earlier this week. “I think he’s got a defensive conscience to his game naturally that he showed up here with. And you combine that with he’ s a really smart kid, so he’s picked up the details of what we want to do fairly quickly.”

The lack of similar qualities often is what makes coaches slow to trust young players. While the Islanders haven’t quite gone into the deep end as far as throwing Eklund into defensive zone faceoffs or minutes late in the third period, they’re not going out of their way to shelter his matchups either.

“He’s not a guy that’s gonna cheat the game for offense,” DeBoer said. “He’ll take his offensive opportunities when they’re there, but he’s got a real good defensive conscience when he’s on the ice, which is really rare for a young guy.”

Thursday was the 43rd regular-season game and 55th game including playoffs between Pete DeBoer and Peter Laviolette.

"من فکر می کنم که او به طور طبیعی در بازی خود وجدان دفاعی دارد که با آن در اینجا حاضر شد.

See more of our coverage in your search results.

An Australian TV reporter and a nearby bystander heroically swam through rising floodwaters to rescue a man trapped in his sinking car — and the remarkable feat was caught on camera.

Will Murray was reporting on heavy rainfall that blanked much of the Brisbane region on Thursday when a man plowed his four-wheel-drive truck through floodwaters in Morayfield, Queensland, the Australian Broadcasting Corporation (ABC) reported.

Murray, who works for the ABC, said the man’s truck stalled and started to sink in the surge of water that rose after over six inches of rain fell that morning.

“I saw him drive in and immediately his car started floating downstream,” Murray recounted to the ABC, noting he quickly dialed emergency services.

WATCH: A TV reporter dives into raging floodwaters to save a driver trapped inside a sinking SUV, pulling the person to safety just moments before the vehicle disappears underwater.ABC journalist Will Murray and another bystander swim toward the vehicle in Morayfield,… pic.twitter.com/dRrU7N3arB

“Initially I could see him, but he disappeared from my sight within seconds, so I made the call to jump in,” he said.

Bystander Daniel Hainey had a similar thought process when he noticed the dangerous situation unfolding.

“The car began to slowly sink deeper and deeper, and that’s when I thought, ‘Oh no, this is not looking good’, so I started swimming in there,” Hainey told the news station.

Murray said he quickly handed his phone to his camera operator, Liz Pickering, and immediately started to swim through the “deep” waters alongside Hainey.

“When we got to the car we tried to open the closest door, no luck, then got on the back of the car with the thought to break the back window,” Murray said.

“I thought to try the passenger side rear door first and put my feet against the car and pulled as hard as I could and with some luck the door swung open.”

The reporter speculated that water flooding in “helped create some pressure to force the door open,” allowing the driver to be pulled from the truck moments before it disappeared beneath the surface.

“All three of us gave each other a big hug and were just so relieved,” Murray recalled. “It was very scary, but happy everyone is safe and relieved it is OK.”

Murray’s camera operator, who captured the heroic rescue effort on video, noted that “the pair of them definitely saved that man’s life.”

The journalist said after returning to safety, the rescued man explained he “didn’t see the signage and didn’t realize how deep it was” when he drove his truck through at speed.

“I had no idea how deep it was and that’s the lesson we keep hearing, isn’t it, that you can’t tell and you really couldn’t,” Murray recalled to the Australian outlet, calling the ordeal “terrifying.”

“It didn’t look particularly severe,” the reporter observed. “But as you can see in the vision, the car completely disappears. It’s clearly very deep in the middle there.”

Having “just witnessed how quickly it can go south,” Murray made a public service announcement on national television.

“Please don’t drive into floodwaters,” he pleaded.

news.originalContent:
High winds propelled the blaze across the army base in Wainwright, killing four soldiers and injuring dozens more.

A fire that killed four soldiers at a western Canadian military base was sparked by an exercise using live grenades, a military official said.

The deadly fire broke out on a grenade launcher range during military exercises on Saturday, with high winds propelling it across the base, Brigadier-General Vanessa Hanrahan, commander of the Canadian Forces Military Police Group, told reporters on Thursday.

“A subsequent change in wind direction and velocity significantly increased the fire’s intensity,” she added, with the flames spreading to a training area at the Wainwright military base in Alberta.

Due to the blaze being in the “permanent danger area” of the range, firefighters were unable to directly combat it, Hanrahan added.

The fire spread on Saturday afternoon during high-intensity combat training involving Charlie Company of the 3rd Battalion, Princess Patricia’s Canadian Light Infantry.

The military base lies in the prairies, a landscape of wide, open grasslands, rolling plains and scattered groves of trees.

About 84 soldiers were split between a grenade range and an area where they practised attacks on simulated enemy positions. The fire swept into the second training area.

Four soldiers died and 39 were injured, with 27 requiring hospitalisation. The incident was one of the worst peacetime tragedies for Canada’s military.

The soldiers and reserve members were participating in exercises ahead of a planned deployment to Latvia, where Canadian forces have their largest international military operation.

The Wainwright base is one of the largest bases operated by the Canadian Armed Forces. It regularly hosts training exercises involving military personnel from NATO countries.

During the final months of World War II and for several months in 1946, the base was used as an internment centre for German prisoners of war.
news.content: وزش باد شدید آتش سوزی را در پایگاه ارتش در Wainwright به حرکت درآورد و چهار سرباز را کشت و ده ها تن دیگر را مجروح کرد. یک مقام نظامی گفت که آتش سوزی که منجر به کشته شدن چهار سرباز در یک پایگاه نظامی در غرب کانادا شد، توسط یک تمرین با استفاده از نارنجک های واقعی شعله ور شد. سرتیپ ونسا هانراهان، فرمانده گروه پلیس نظامی نیروهای کانادایی روز پنجشنبه به خبرنگاران گفت که آتش سوزی مرگبار در یک نارنجک انداز در حین تمرینات نظامی در روز شنبه رخ داد و باد شدید آن را به سراسر پایگاه می برد. وی افزود: «تغییر بعدی در جهت و سرعت باد شدت آتش را به طور قابل توجهی افزایش داد» و شعله های آتش به یک منطقه آموزشی در پایگاه نظامی واینرایت در آلبرتا سرایت کرد. به دلیل قرار گرفتن آتش در «منطقه خطر دائمی» محدوده، آتش نشانان قادر به مبارزه مستقیم با آن نبودند. آتش بعد از ظهر شنبه در جریان تمرینات رزمی شدید شامل شرکت چارلی از گردان سوم، پیاده نظام سبک کانادایی پرنسس پاتریشیا گسترش یافت. پایگاه نظامی در چمنزارها، منظره‌ای از علفزارهای وسیع و باز، دشت‌های متحرک و بیشه‌های پراکنده درختان قرار دارد. حدوداً 84 سرباز در حال حمله بودند. در مواضع شبیه سازی شده دشمن آتش سوزی منطقه دوم آموزشی را فرا گرفت. چهار سرباز جان باختند و 39 نفر مجروح شدند که 27 نفر نیاز به بستری شدن در بیمارستان داشتند. این حادثه یکی از بدترین تراژدی های زمان صلح برای ارتش کانادا بود. سربازان و من را رزرو می کنند

news.originalContent:
Karachi’s last two African elephants remain in captivity. Their sisters are already dead. Will they survive?

At Karachi Zoo, Jude Allen sang, You Are My Sunshine, to an elephant he could not save.

Noor Jehan, the 17-year-old African elephant, was suffering. Allen recalls massaging her legs, nursing her bedsores and spending her final days beside her.

She died on April 22, 2023, surrounded by a few activists. Allen, 45, had held various corporate jobs while volunteering as an animal caregiver since an early age.

But Noor Jehan changed something in him, he said. “The day this wild African elephant rested her painful forehead on mine, and I hugged her for the first time – it all made sense,” he tells Al Jazeera.

“I quit my job without a plan B.”

Now three years later, Allen has turned the grief of Noor Jehan’s loss into care for one of her sisters, Madhubala, who also faces major health challenges. He is part of a growing campaign of Pakistani and international activists and doctors trying to save Madhubala, a victim, her carers say, not just of medical conditions, but also of a system that is simply unable to give animals in captivity the attention and facilities they need.

In 2009, four elephant calves captured in Tanzania were brought to Pakistan, allegedly through an animal trader.

Two of them, Noor Jehan and Madhubala, were kept at the Karachi Zoo, while their sisters Sonia and Malika were taken to Safari Park, a larger facility also in Pakistan’s largest city that has both a zoo and other viewing spaces for visitors to watch animals up close.

Then, in 2020, Pakistan was gripped by the story of Kaavan, an Asian elephant that had spent 35 years in the capital city of Islamabad, eight of them alone after his companion Saheli died. Four Paws, an international animal welfare organisation, helped move Kaavan to an animal sanctuary in Cambodia, where he now lives with other elephants.

That episode also shone a light on the Karachi sisters. At the time, Allen was helping a friend with another animal shelter, and came to know Four Paws was in town. He reached out to them, and they led him to Noor Jehan and Madhubala.

By 2021, Noor Jehan’s tusk was infected. She suffered from malnutrition and stress, too.

Allen and the other activists couldn’t save Noor Jehan, but the campaign had turned into a wider cry, demanding care and justice for captive animals in the urban jungle of Karachi, the coastal home to 20 million people.

One animal in particular became the focus of attention.

Named after an iconic Indian film actress from the mid-20th century, Madhubala was now the only African elephant at the Karachi Metropolitan Corporation-run zoo. She was alone, banging her head against the gate of her enclosure, Allen recalls. “She didn’t have a friend.”

Allen says she needed company – she wanted a friend.

Allen, along with Four Paws, helped prepare her for a move to Safari Park, so she could join her sister elephants, Sonia and Malika.

Four Paws assessed the elephants and found that they needed better diets, enrichment and medical treatment. The organisation recommended reuniting them.

The reunion came in November 2024. Four Paws documented the meeting between the siblings at Safari Park. Sonia approached Madhubala first. Malika followed. The three touched one another with their trunks and drank together.

But days later, on December 8, Sonia died, aged about 19, after collapsing in her enclosure. The park’s director initially described an apparent heart failure. Subsequent findings, reported by Four Paws, identified a severe bacterial infection associated with an advanced abscess on her foot.

Amir Khalil, a Four Paws wildlife vet involved in the elephants’ care, told The Associated Press at the time that “such infections don’t spread in one day”. Four Paws linked her death to prolonged unsuitable living conditions and malnutrition.

Meanwhile, Madhubala and Malika were both diagnosed with tuberculosis, although recent examinations reported by her veterinarian have indicated that Madhubala is no longer testing positive.

Now Madhubala, 22, is recovering after losing more than 200kg (440 pounds) and becoming too weak to get up safely after lying down.

Khalil, who has also rescued wild animals from multiple conflict zones, is one of the carers who has taken charge of Madhubala’s recovery. He told Al Jazeera that Madhubala had recovered 85 percent of her ability to walk, and was a good patient: “She really wants to follow the standard operation procedure and to adhere to the programme that I put in,” he says. That includes a “water massage for the leg with high-pressure water”.

He says the required medication needs to be administered properly, and treating all the wounds – and they were getting better when he left Pakistan a few days ago.

For Allen, the work began with Noor Jehan.

While she was unwell, he says he visited the zoo daily, checking that the elephants received their food on time and in the right quantities. During Noor Jehan’s final 10 days, he was a near-permanent presence there, assisting the medical team however he could.

Her death became the beginning of the “I Am Noor Jehan” movement, which Allen leads for animals in captivity. The Pakistan Animal Welfare Society (PAWS), with I Am Noor Jehan, held a memorial for Noor Jehan with artists, filmmakers, and other animal activists.

Then came Madhubala. Preparing her to enter a transport crate required patience. Allen describes an elephant who could be aggressive and difficult to approach. Four Paws specialists helped him understand her needs.

But delays to the relocation disrupted the training, he says. Madhubala became frustrated and bored. Allen tried football.

He entered her enclosure, an approach he acknowledges Four Paws did not endorse. The caretakers warned him too: Madhubala wasn’t in a playful mood.

But within 20 minutes, he says, Madhubala wanted the ball.

She picked it up with her trunk and hid it between her legs. Then she began teasing her caretakers who were trying to retrieve it, offering the ball before concealing it again.

The sessions helped him build a relationship with her, he says. Madhubala began responding eagerly to training again.

“Earning her trust was the most significant accomplishment.”

That trust is especially important to Allen because he believes that Noor Jehan, and then Sonia, could have been saved.

When Sonia was unwell, Allen says he had raised concerns with local authorities about her weight loss and a swelling beneath her body. He says those warnings were not adequately acted upon.

“I felt I betrayed Sonia.”

The deaths of two of the four African elephants in Karachi raise questions about the resources, expertise and accountability behind keeping wild animals in public institutions, experts say.

Karachi Municipal Corporation has not procured any animals in the last 20 years, and the elephants were brought in long before his time, Karachi Mayor Murtaza Wahab said, speaking to Al Jazeera.

“I’ve always said that animal welfare should be paramount. Anyone who wants to come join hands, to look after the animal, we would be ready and willing to work with them,” he said.

He argued that his team at KMC had done whatever it could to look after Madhubala with Khalil and other doctors.

“Madhubala was being treated, and the good thing is, now, Dr Khalil is also saying things are moving in the right direction and we’ve got a third-party perspective endorsing whatever was being done,” Wahab said.

But Allen says Safari Park, where Madhubala was moved after Noor Jehan’s death, has been a disappointment. Allen says he helped develop Madhubala’s new enclosure there, working on landscaping and the procedures that caregivers needed to use to help her.

Moving her was supposed to change the conditions of her life. But at Safari Park, he says, people come right up to the elephants, feed them, and treat the facility like a zoo.

“What was meant to be a sanctuary became a zoo,” he says.

Javed Maher, the top wildlife official in the government of Sindh, the province containing Karachi, says elephants and wildlife need to be in their own habitat, and people caring for them need to have knowledge of animals.

Currently, the Safari Park enclosure for elephants is about 14 hectares, roughly 35 acres, according to Four Paws.

Mahar says he offered hundreds of acres in the rural country for these elephants so they can live freely.

“Karachi Zoo, along with the majority of the zoos of the country, is not capable,” he says.

But the elephants have remained at Safari Park.

The above photo needs a credit -TSL

Former Islamabad High Court Chief Justice Athar Minallah, in a landmark 2020 judgement, declared that animals had rights. It was that ruling that enabled the transfer of Kaavan to Cambodia, and two Himalayan bears to a sanctuary in Jordan. The zoo in Islamabad was closed, and all 878 animals kept there were released or relocated.

“That judgement remains the law, as no appeal was filed against it,” says Minallah speaking to Al Jazeera.

“Under this jurisprudence, Madhubala has the right to live in an environment where her social, behavioural, and psychological needs can be met,” he says.

To be sure, the challenges that officials like those at KMC and elsewhere face are also real.

Pakistan already faces profound human hardship. A United Nations account published in March says more than 60 percent of people in the country cannot afford a healthy diet.

Acquiring animals that require specialist care creates obligations lasting decades. Once confined, they depend on people for every meal, for movement, companionship and treatment.

But that, say analysts, is even more reason to “stop keeping them in our custody”, says Allen.

He last saw Madhubala on October 8, when he was assisting the Four Paws team. When there are lots of people, he says, she gets distracted easily.

But she can also get jealous for Allen’s attention. “She will literally throw rocks if she can at anyone talking to me,” he smiled.
news.content: دو فیل آفریقایی آخر کراچی در اسارت هستند. خواهران آنها قبلاً مرده اند. آیا آنها زنده خواهند ماند؟در باغ وحش کراچی، جود آلن برای فیلی که نتوانست نجاتش دهد، آواز تو آفتاب من هستی را خواند. نور جیهان، فیل 17 ساله آفریقایی، رنج می برد. آلن به یاد می‌آورد که پاهایش را ماساژ داده، از زخم‌های بسترش پرستاری کرده و روزهای آخر خود را در کنار او گذرانده است. او در 22 آوریل 2023 در محاصره چند فعال درگذشت. آلن، 45 ساله، در حالی که از سنین پایین به عنوان مراقبت از حیوانات داوطلب می شد، مشاغل مختلف شرکتی را بر عهده داشت. او گفت که نور جهان چیزی را در او تغییر داد. او به الجزیره می گوید: «روزی که این فیل آفریقایی وحشی پیشانی دردناکش را روی پیشانی من گذاشت و من برای اولین بار او را در آغوش گرفتم - همه چیز منطقی بود. اکنون پس از گذشت سه سال، آلن غم از دست دادن نور جیهان را به مراقبت از یکی از خواهرانش به نام مادوبالا تبدیل کرده است، که او نیز با چالش های بهداشتی بزرگی مواجه است. او بخشی از کمپین رو به رشد فعالان و پزشکان پاکستانی و بین‌المللی است که تلاش می‌کنند مادوبالا، قربانی را نجات دهند، نه تنها به دلیل شرایط پزشکی، بلکه همچنین از سیستمی که به سادگی قادر نیست به حیوانات در اسارت توجه و امکانات مورد نیازشان را بدهد. در سال 2009، چهار گوساله فیل که در تانزانیا اسیر شده بودند، ظاهراً از طریق یک تاجر حیوانات به پاکستان آورده شدند. دو نفر از آنها، نور جیهان و مادوبالا، در باغ وحش کراچی نگهداری شدند، در حالی که خواهرانشان سونیا و مالیکا به پارک سافاری، یک مرکز بزرگ‌تر در بزرگترین شهر پاکستان نیز منتقل شدند.

news.originalContent:
Israeli pogroms on Palestinian farmers and their lands during the olive harvest season intensify.

Israeli forces have arrested 36 Palestinians during raids across the occupied West Bank, as attacks on Palestinian farmers and their lands during the olive harvest season ramp up.

In Jenin governorate, Israeli forces raided towns and villages on Thursday, arresting 10 Palestinians, the Palestinian news agency Wafa reported, citing data from the Palestinian Prisoner’s Society.

Israeli forces also raided the town of Tuqu in the Hebron governorate on Thursday and arrested former prisoner Shorok al-Badan, along with five others from other parts of Hebron, according to Wafa.

The Colonization and Wall Resistance Commission said on Thursday that Israeli forces arrested 14 people in Khirbet Jawaya village of Masafer Yatta in Hebron, while Wafa reported that three other Palestinians were arrested across the Hebron governorate, citing a security source.

In Nablus and Jerusalem, three more Palestinians were arrested during Israeli raids in the village of Burin, the town of Awarta, and the Qalandiya refugee camp.

The Colonization and Wall Resistance Commission said it documented 17 pogroms by Israeli forces and settlers on Thursday against Palestinian farmers and their land during the olive harvest.

The incidents were recorded across occupied West Bank governorates, including Hebron, Qalqilya, Nablus, Ramallah and el-Bireh, Jenin and Salfit.

According to the Commission, the attacks included assaults on farmers, preventing them from reaching their land, theft of crops and agricultural equipment, damage and burning of olive trees, as well as arrests, threats at gunpoint and live fire.

The Commission says the pattern represents an escalation in attacks targeting the olive harvest and undermines Palestinians’ ability to access and cultivate their land and maintain their livelihoods.

Israeli attacks on Palestinian farmers garnered international attention and condemnation. US Democratic congressional candidate Brad Lander was briefly detained on Wednesday by the Israeli military with a warning while volunteering to help Palestinian farmers harvest olives in the occupied West Bank.

news.originalContent:
Tech-heavy Nasdaq falls 2.6 percent as debate rages over whether AI is a bubble.

US tech stocks have dropped sharply amid market jitters over the sustainability of companies’ enormous capital investments in AI.

The Nasdaq Composite, which is dominated by tech firms linked to the AI boom, fell 2.6 percent on Thursday, its steepest fall since the index tumbled 4.2 percent on June 5.

The broader S&P 500 slid 1.21 percent, the benchmark’s biggest drop since a 1.52 percent decline on July 29.

Apart from Apple, each of the “Magnificent 7”, which make up more than one-third of the overall market, saw substantial losses.

Meta dropped nearly 7 percent after it raised its projected capital spending for this year to $135bn to $145bn in its latest earnings report, even as the Facebook parent company’s net profit fell short of expectations.

Amazon fell 4.6 percent, while Nvidia dropped 4.4 percent.

Tesla and Alphabet both fell 3.1 percent, while Microsoft declined 2.2 percent.

The sell-off extended to other major tech players, including Intel and Advanced Micro Devices, both of which fell about 8 percent, and Broadcom, which slid 4.3 percent.

After the losses, the Nasdaq is about 5.8 percent off its all-time high, reached on October 6.

Rising oil prices since February, due to the fallout of the US-Israel war on Iran, added to the downbeat mood.

Brent crude futures rose 4 percent on Thursday and continued to climb on Friday morning, taking the international benchmark above $114.20 a barrel, its highest since May.

Major stock markets in Asia opened lower on Friday, following the losses on Wall Street.

Japan’s benchmark Nikkei 225 fell more than 2 percent in morning trading before recovering some ground, while South Korea’s KOSPI dropped as much as 3.5 percent.

The Hang Seng Index in Hong Kong fell about 0.5 percent.

Jay Goldberg, a senior analyst at Seaport Research Partners in San Francisco, said the swings in the market appeared to be driven more by sentiment than underlying fundamentals.

“In short, nothing has changed. Investors have just decided to be afraid this week. Everyone I speak to points to a different cause for the downfall … It’s just a giant wall of worry,” Goldberg told Al Jazeera.

“There are legitimate concerns about the AI trade, but this level of shift in the markets is driven much more by investor sentiment than any tangible reason.”

US tech companies’ huge investments in AI have stoked intense debate about whether a market bubble is forming similar to the one that preceded the 2000 dot-com crash.

While some Wall Street analysts view current levels of investment in datacentres and graphics processing units as unsustainable, others argue that AI will revolutionise society to a degree that justifies the eye-watering sums involved.

Global AI investment is forecast to reach $2.7 trillion in 2026 and $3.6 trillion in 2027, according to technology insights company Gartner.

news.originalContent:
No date has been set to decide on a successor for Nicolas Maduro after the former president was captured by US forces.

Thousands of Venezuelans have taken to the streets in several cities to demand free elections and other political changes, in the first nationwide opposition protest in nearly two years.

US President Donald Trump and acting President Delcy Rodriguez have said there would be elections, but no date has been set for a vote to decide on a successor for Nicolas Maduro, after the former Venezuelan president was captured by US forces in a military raid in January.

Opposition leader and Nobel Peace Prize winner Maria Corina Machado, who has been outside the country for nearly a year after living in hiding following a contested 2024 election, has said elections must take place by July 2027.

Her Vente Venezuela movement organised the protest, which took place in the capital Caracas and other cities, including Valencia, Maracay, San Cristobal and Maracaibo.

“Seeing this makes me happy because I know change is possible,” said 18-year-old cosmetology student Leosmary Hernandez, as she gathered with hundreds of others in northern Maracay. “I’ve been through so many hardships, so many problems because of the dollar, and difficulties studying. I have high hopes for my country and for our next leader and president, Maria Corina.”

“I went out to protest before, when things were much tougher, and I’m even less afraid today because I want my voice to be heard,” she added.

Since January 3, the country has been led by interim President Delcy Rodriguez of the long-governing United Socialist Party of Venezuela (PSUV).

PSUV leaders have been accused of carrying out human rights abuses against political dissidents, including arbitrary arrest, imprisonment and torture.

After the United States launched a military operation to abduct and jail former President Nicolas Maduro, the PSUV remained in power with the support of the White House.

US President Trump has backed Rodriguez’s leadership, despite her having been Maduro’s vice president.

His administration has maintained an active role in Venezuela, exerting control over its oil resources and pressuring the Rodriguez government for reforms.

Venezuela’s socialist movement, in power since 1999 under late President Hugo Chavez and then Maduro, has in the past deployed security forces against protesters, but government forces had minimal presence at protest sites on Thursday, and in many smaller cities demonstrators dispersed before dark.

The ruling Socialist Party called for its supporters to march from Caracas’ Plaza Venezuela, the same place the opposition planned to gather two hours later, to a location near the presidential palace to commemorate Breast Cancer Awareness Month.

Interior Minister Diosdado Cabello, known for his close ties to the security services, was pictured on state television attending the march, while the opposition supporters moved their protest to a nearby location.

Talks between a faction of the opposition and the interim government, aimed at remaking the top court and the electoral council ahead of eventual elections, held their latest session this month, but changes could take significant time.

The negotiations, backed by the US, do not include Machado’s political movement, though she has said she will not stand in the way of their progress.

Machado’s proxy Edmundo Gonzalez Urrutia claims to have won the 2024 election according to vote tallies by the opposition. But the government, which never released full counts, backed Maduro, as did the country’s legal and electoral institutions.

Machado has for years sought US support, aligning with hawks in the Trump team who argued that Maduro, through alleged links to drug gangs, represented a direct threat to US national security. Maduro and his wife, Cilia Flores, are facing drug and torture charges in the US. They have pleaded not guilty.
news.content: هیچ تاریخی برای تصمیم گیری در مورد جانشین نیکلاس مادورو پس از دستگیری رئیس جمهور سابق توسط نیروهای آمریکایی تعیین نشده است. هزاران نفر از مردم ونزوئلا در چندین شهر به خیابان ها ریخته اند تا خواستار برگزاری انتخابات آزاد و سایر تغییرات سیاسی شوند، در اولین اعتراض سراسری مخالفان در نزدیک به دو سال گذشته. دونالد ترامپ، رئیس‌جمهور آمریکا و دلسی رودریگز، رئیس‌جمهور موقت، گفته‌اند که انتخابات برگزار خواهد شد، اما هیچ تاریخی برای رای‌گیری برای تصمیم‌گیری در مورد جانشین نیکلاس مادورو، پس از دستگیری رئیس‌جمهور سابق ونزوئلا توسط نیروهای آمریکایی در یک حمله نظامی در ژانویه تعیین نشده است. ماریا کورینا ماچادو، رهبر مخالفان و برنده جایزه صلح نوبل، که نزدیک به یک سال پس از مخفی شدن پس از انتخابات رقابتی 2024 در خارج از کشور بوده است، گفته است که انتخابات باید تا ژوئیه 2027 برگزار شود. جنبش Vente Venezuela او این تظاهرات را سازماندهی کرد که در پایتخت کاراکاس و شهرهای دیگر از جمله والنسیا، ماراکاسیا و ماراکابای برگزار شد. لئوسماری هرناندز، دانشجوی 18 ساله زیبایی، در حالی که با صدها نفر دیگر در شمال ماراکای جمع شده بود، گفت: «دیدن این موضوع باعث خوشحالی من می‌شود، زیرا می‌دانم تغییر ممکن است. من سختی‌های زیادی را پشت سر گذاشته‌ام، مشکلات زیادی به خاطر دلار و مشکلات تحصیلی را پشت سر گذاشته‌ام. من به کشورم و رهبر و رئیس‌جمهور بعدی‌مان، ماریا کورینا، امید زیادی دارم.» او افزود: «من قبلاً برای اعتراض بیرون رفتم، زمانی که شرایط بسیار سخت‌تر بود، و امروز حتی کمتر می‌ترسم زیرا می‌خواهم صدایم شنیده شود.

news.originalContent:
در ساعات شلوغی ترافیک در ناصره، بزرگ‌ترین شهر عرب‌نشین اسرائیل، دانشجویان کنار خیابان بروشورهایی توزیع می‌کنند و از رانندگان می‌خواهند در انتخابات سراسری و رقابتی شرکت کنند. نظرسنجی‌ها نشان می‌دهد که احزاب عرب ممکن است در موقعیتی قرار گیرند که نقشی تعیین‌کننده در موازنه قدرت ایفا کنند.

سرخوردگی سیاسی در گذشته اغلب باعث کاهش مشارکت عرب‌های اسرائیل در انتخابات شده است؛ گروهی که حدود یک‌پنجم جمعیت کشور را تشکیل می‌دهند و بسیاری از آنها خود را شهروندان فلسطینی اسرائیل می‌دانند. اما در این انتخابات، تلاش گسترده‌ای برای کنار زدن راست‌گراترین ائتلاف حاکم در تاریخ اسرائیل در جریان است؛ ائتلافی متشکل از بنیامین نتانیاهو، نخست‌وزیر کهنه‌کار اسرائیل، و احزاب راست افراطی و فوق‌ارتدکس.

آرکان بدران، ۲۳ ساله، که همراه دانشجویان در حال توزیع بروشور است، می‌گوید:«من وظیفه خود می‌دانم که به سرنگونی این دولت افراطی کمک کنیم. آنها با ما مانند شهروندان درجه دو رفتار می‌کنند.»

او می‌افزاید:«از همه زنان و مردان جوان می‌خواهم به فهرست‌های عربی رای بدهند؛ فهرست‌هایی که نماینده ما هستند، چون این به آینده ما مربوط می‌شود.»

بیشتر نظرسنجی‌ها نشان می‌دهند که نه بنیامین نتانیاهو و متحدانش و نه «ائتلاف تغییر» به رهبری گادی آیزنکوت، رئیس پیشین ستاد ارتش اسرائیل، مسیر روشنی برای دستیابی به اکثریت پارلمانی ندارند.

اگر این نظرسنجی‌ها درست باشند، احزاب مخالف نتانیاهو که پس از انتخابات خواهان تشکیل دولت ائتلافی هستند، یا باید از وعده خود مبنی بر همکاری نکردن با نخست‌وزیر عقب‌نشینی کنند یا با احزاب عمدتا عرب اسرائیل به توافق برسند.

یکی از موانع اصلی این است که آیزنکوت تاکنون تشکیل دولت با حمایت احزاب عرب را رد کرده و دلیل آن را نبود ارزش‌های مشترک عنوان کرده است.

سیاست و جامعه اسرائیل پس از حمله مرگبار و بی‌سابقه حماس به این کشور در ۷ اکتبر ۲۰۲۳ و جنگ متعاقب آن در غزه دستخوش تغییر شده است. بی‌اعتمادی و دشمنی نسبت به اقلیت عرب اسرائیل نیز افزایش یافته است.

گزیده‌ای از مهم‌ترین خبرها، گزارش‌های میدانی و گفت‌وگوهای اختصاصی را هر هفته در ایمیل خود دریافت کنید.

سهی سلمان موسی از مرکز مساوات در شهر ناصره، نهادی که برای برابری حقوق شهروندان عرب فعالیت می‌کند می‌گوید «پس از ۷ اکتبر، با ما طوری رفتار می‌شد که گویی دشمن این کشور هستیم،»

او می‌گوید: «فضا برای آزادی بیان محدودتر شد. بازداشت‌های گسترده‌ای صورت گرفت و افرادی هم بودند که به دلیل انتشار مطلبی در شبکه‌های اجتماعی یا مخالفت با جنگ غزه، از محل کارشان اخراج شدند.»

سهی سلمان موسی، برخی وزیران دولت اسرائیل را به «تبعیض نظام‌مند و تحریک علیه عرب‌های اسرائیلی» متهم می‌کند.

گروه‌های جامعه مدنی نیز می‌گویند بودجه‌های اختصاص‌یافته به جوامع عرب‌نشین به‌طور نامتناسبی کاهش یافته است. دولت اسرائیل در مقابل می‌گوید این کاهش بودجه‌ها برای تامین هزینه‌های دفاعی و امنیتی دوران جنگ ضروری بوده است.

همچنین کارزارهایی با انگیزه‌های سیاسی علیه پزشکان عرب شاغل در بیمارستان‌های اسرائیل به راه افتاده و رانندگان عرب اتوبوس نیز هدف حملات با انگیزه‌های نژادی از سوی برخی شهروندان یهودی اسرائیل قرار گرفته‌اند.

برخی فعالیت‌های انتخاباتی نیز کوشیده‌اند با عمیق‌تر کردن شکاف‌های اجتماعی از این فضا بهره‌برداری کنند.

بتسالل اسموتریچ، وزیر دارایی راست افراطی اسرائیل، وعده داده است بخش‌هایی از مناطق جلیل در شمال و نقب در جنوب، که بیشتر جمعیت عرب در آنها زندگی می‌کنند، را «یهودی‌سازی» کند. او این سیاست را با گسترش شهرک‌سازی در کرانه غربی اشغالی مقایسه کرده است.

اکثریت عرب‌های اسرائیل از نسل فلسطینیانی هستند که در جریان جنگی که با تشکیل دولت اسرائیل در سال ۱۹۴۸ همراه بود، در سرزمین‌هایی که بعدها به اسرائیل تبدیل شد باقی ماندند؛ جنگی که طی آن صدها هزار نفر از خانه‌های خود رانده شدند یا از آنها گریختند.

دولت کنونی اسرائیل اغلب این شهروندان را تهدیدی برای هویت یهودی کشور معرفی می‌کند. نخست‌وزیر اسرائیل نیز اخیرا مدعی شده که رقبایش قصد دارند با احزاب عرب متحد شوند و یک «دولت خطرناک» تشکیل دهند.

برای تاکید بر این پیام، ستاد انتخاباتی او بیلبوردهایی در نقاط مختلف نصب کرده است؛ از جمله در یک تقاطع جاده‌ای در ورودی اصلی شهر ناصره.

این بیلبوردها انتخاب را میان «راستگرایان یا فلسطین» به تصویر می‌کشند و در آنها چهره‌های اصلی اپوزیسیون، از جمله برخی سیاستمداران راست‌گرا، به‌عنوان نمایندگان گزینه دوم و نه اول نمایش داده شده‌اند.

ستاد انتخاباتی نتانیاهو همچنین از ویدئوهای تولیدشده با هوش مصنوعی استفاده کرده است تا رقبای او را در حال در آغوش گرفتن رهبران عرب نشان دهد.

در ایستگاه رادیویی «ناس» در ناصره، که از ایستگاه‌های پرمخاطب عرب‌زبان است، با محمد مغادلی دیدار می‌کنم؛ گوینده اخبار که هم‌زمان تحلیلگر شبکه ۱۲ اسرائیل نیز هست.

پدر او، بین سال‌های ۲۰۰۷ تا ۲۰۰۹ به نمایندگی از حزب کارگر، نخستین وزیر مسلمان اسرائیل بود.

از او می‌پرسم که درباره امتناع رهبران «ائتلاف تغییر» از همکاری با احزاب عرب اسرائیل چه نظری دارد.

او می‌گوید: «اگر بخواهم در یک کلمه بگویم، این نژادپرستی است. اما اگر بخواهیم توضیح دهیم چرا، دلیلش منافع سیاسی بنیامین نتانیاهو است. او مدام تلاش می‌کند مشروعیت احزاب عرب را زیر سوال ببرد؛ چون عرب هستند، چون فلسطینی هستند. این رویکرد بر اکثریت احزاب یهودی در اسرائیل هم تاثیر گذاشته است.»

نظرسنجی‌های این هفته نشان داده‌اند که هم ائتلاف آیزنکوت و هم ائتلاف مذهبی-ملی‌گرای نتانیاهو ممکن است هر کدام حدود ۵۰ کرسی از مجموع ۱۲۰ کرسی پارلمان اسرائیل را به دست آورند، در حالی که در مجموع ۱۳ یا ۱۴ کرسی می‌تواند به گروه‌های عمدتا عرب‌نشین برسد.

این گروه‌ها شامل «فهرست مشترک عربی» هستند؛ ائتلافی از احزاب حدش، بلد و تعال، و همچنین «فهرست متحد عربی» که حزبی اسلام‌گرا به رهبری منصور عباس است.

حزب منصور عباس در اصل به‌عنوان بخشی از «جنبش اسلامی» در اسرائیل شکل گرفت؛ جریانی که ارزش‌های اجتماعی محافظه‌کارانه دارد. با این حال، عباس به خاطر همکاری با شرکای یهودی شناخته شده است. او حل مشکلات عرب‌های اسرائیل را در اولویت قرار می‌دهد و نسبت به مسائل فلسطینیان در کرانه غربی و غزه کمتر سخن می‌گوید.

عباس پیش‌تر طعم قدرت را چشیده است. او در سال ۲۰۲۱ در دولت ائتلافی کوتاه‌مدتی که به رهبری نفتالی بنت تشکیل شد، به مقام وزارت رسید؛ بنت اکنون از چهره‌های راست‌گرای ائتلاف آیزنکوت به شمار می‌رود.

عباس برای انتخابات پیش رو اقدامی غیرمنتظره انجام داده و رتبه دوم فهرست انتخاباتی خود را به یوآو سگالوویتس، مقام پیشین پلیس و نماینده میانه‌روی پارلمان اسرائیل که یهودی است، واگذار کرده است.

عباس بر این باور است که آیزنکوت و دیگر رهبران سیاسی پس از انتخابات آمادگی بیشتری برای همکاری با حزب او خواهند داشت و تاکید می‌کند که می‌خواهد در دولت آینده حضور داشته باشد.

او به من گفت:«به این نتیجه رسیده‌ایم که صرف داشتن نمایندگی در پارلمان برای خدمت به جامعه عرب کافی نیست. تصمیم گرفتیم مسئولیت‌پذیر باشیم، بخشی از راه‌حل مشکلات خود شویم و برای عرب‌ها و یهودیان امید ایجاد کنیم.»

او افزود:«به همین دلیل، رویکرد ما همواره بر دستیابی به جایگاهی تاثیرگذار استوار بوده، نه صرفا حضور و نمایندگی در پارلمان.»

در همین حال، «فهرست مشترک» که از احزاب سکولار تشکیل شده و از برابری حقوق عرب‌های اسرائیل، پایان اشغال نظامی سرزمین‌های فلسطینی و راه‌حل دو کشوری برای مناقشه اسرائیل و فلسطینیان حمایت می‌کند، در پی آن است که در جایگاهی تاثیرگذار در صف مخالفان دولت قرار گیرد.

رهبران این ائتلاف از ایجاد یک «حاشیه امن» انتخاباتی برای گروه‌هایی سخن می‌گویند که ممکن است بتوانند جایگزین دولت نتانیاهو شوند؛ حمایتی که در ازای پیشبرد برخی سیاست‌های مهم ارائه خواهد شد.

یکی از مهم‌ترین موضوعات این انتخابات برای عرب‌های اسرائیل، گسترش جرایم سازمان‌یافته و فعالیت باندهای تبهکار است.

در ماه سپتامبر، نظرسنجی موسسه پژوهشی «دموکراسی اسرائیل» نشان داد که برای ۵۳/۵ درصد از شهروندان عرب اسرائیل، این موضوع مهم‌ترین عامل در تصمیم‌گیری برای رای دادن به یک حزب سیاسی است.

بر اساس آمار «ابتکار ابراهیم»، یک سازمان مشترک عربی-یهودی که برای همزیستی فعالیت می‌کند، شمار قتل‌ها در جامعه عرب اسرائیل سال گذشته به رکورد ۲۵۲ مورد رسید؛ رقمی که حدود پنج برابر تعداد شهروندان یهودی اسرائیلی است که در همان دوره کشته شده‌اند.

در یافا، محله‌ای عربی-یهودی که اکنون بخشی از تل‌آویو به شمار می‌رود، زیاد سمونی جایی را به من نشان می‌دهد که پسرش حسین، نوامبر گذشته در نزدیکی خانه‌اش به دست دو فرد مسلح سوار بر موتورسیکلت هدف گلوله قرار گرفت و کشته شد.

در پرونده او تاکنون هیچ فردی بازداشت نشده است. با توجه به پایین بودن نرخ کشف این پرونده‌ها، عرب‌های اسرائیل دولت را به بی‌عملی متهم می‌کنند.

سمونی که اکنون عضو گروه حمایتی «خانواده‌های داغدار اسرائیلی-فلسطینی برای صلح» است، می‌گوید: «انگار علاقه‌ای وجود دارد که اوضاع به سمتی برود که قاتل هرگز پیدا نشود و عرب‌ها در جامعه عرب همچنان یکدیگر را بکشند.»

پلیس اسرائیل در پاسخ به بی‌بی‌سی اعلام کرد که تحقیقات درباره قتل حسین همچنان ادامه دارد و افزود که «هر مورد خشونت و جرم را با نهایت جدیت» پیگیری می‌کند.

سمونی به من می‌گوید:«به‌عنوان پدری که پسرش را از دست داده، طبیعی است که بخواهم این خونریزی پایان یابد. آرزو می‌کنم هر شهروند عربی که معتقد است باید تغییری ایجاد شود، بداند که اکنون زمان رفتن پای صندوق رای است.»

دیوان عالی اسرائیل در ماه جاری تصمیم کمیته مرکزی انتخابات را برای رد صلاحیت «فهرست متحد عربی»، «فهرست مشترک» و همچنین دو نفر از اعضای این دو فهرست لغو کرد.

این کمیته که اکثریت آن را اعضای ائتلاف حاکم تشکیل می‌دهند، استدلال کرده بود که این احزاب و نامزدها قانونی را نقض کرده‌اند که بر اساس آن، افرادی که موجودیت اسرائیل به‌عنوان یک کشور یهودی را انکار کنند، حق نامزدی در انتخابات را ندارند. این احزاب و نمایندگانشان این اتهام را قاطعانه رد کرده‌اند.

اکنون و تنها چند روز مانده به رای‌گیری، در ناصره، برخی رانندگان پرچم حزب مورد حمایت خود را بر خودروهایشان نصب کرده‌اند.

اهمیت این انتخابات بسیار زیاد است: شهروندان عرب اسرائیل ممکن است نقشی تعیین‌کننده در مشخص کردن این داشته باشند که چه کسی قدرت را در اسرائیل در دست خواهد گرفت. آنها همچنین این رای‌گیری را برای آینده خود در این کشور بسیار مهم می‌دانند.
